paras.en: The second planet was inhabited by a conceited man:
paras.zh: 第二颗星球上住着一个爱虚荣的人：

paras.en: “Ah! Ah! An admirer has come to visit!” called the conceited man from a distance, as soon as he caught sight of the little prince.
paras.zh: “啊！啊！有个仰慕我的人来拜访了！”爱虚荣的人一看见小王子，就远远地叫了起来。

paras.en: For, to conceited men, all other men are admirers.
paras.zh: 因为，在爱虚荣的人眼里，别人都是仰慕自己的人。

paras.en: “Hello,” said the little prince. “You have a funny hat.”
paras.zh: “您好，”小王子说，“您的帽子真奇怪。”

paras.en: “It’s for greeting people,” the conceited man replied. “It’s for greeting people when they cheer for me. Unfortunately, no one ever passes this way.”
paras.zh: “这是用来致意的，”爱虚荣的人回答他，“这是用来在人们为我欢呼时致意的。可惜，从来没有人经过这里。”

paras.en: “Oh, really?” said the little prince, who did not understand.
paras.zh: “啊，是吗？”小王子说，他没听明白。

paras.en: “Clap your hands together,” the conceited man then suggested.
paras.zh: “把两只手合起来拍一拍吧。”爱虚荣的人于是提议。

paras.en: The little prince clapped his hands together. The conceited man lifted his hat in a modest greeting.
paras.zh: 小王子把两只手合起来拍了拍。爱虚荣的人抬起帽子，谦逊地致意。

paras.en: “This is more fun than visiting the king,” the little prince said to himself. And he began clapping his hands together again. The conceited man began lifting his hat in greeting again.
paras.zh: “这比拜访国王更有趣。”小王子心里想。于是他又把两只手合起来拍了起来。爱虚荣的人又抬起帽子致意。

paras.en: After five minutes of this exercise, the little prince grew tired of the sameness of the game:
paras.zh: 这样做了五分钟，小王子便厌倦了这单调的游戏：

paras.en: “And what do I have to do,” he asked, “to make the hat fall?”
paras.zh: “那要让帽子掉下来，”他问，“该怎么做呢？”

paras.en: But the conceited man did not hear him. Conceited men never hear anything but praise.
paras.zh: 可是，爱虚荣的人没有听见他的话。爱虚荣的人从来只听得见赞美。

paras.en: “Do you really admire me very much?” he asked the little prince.
paras.zh: “你真的非常崇拜我吗？”他问小王子。

paras.en: “What does ‘admire’ mean?”
paras.zh: “‘崇拜’是什么意思？”

paras.en: “To admire means to recognise that I am the most handsome, the best dressed, the richest and the most intelligent man on the planet.”
paras.zh: “崇拜就是承认，我是这颗星球上最好看、穿得最好、最富有、最聪明的人。”

paras.en: “But you are alone on your planet!”
paras.zh: “可是你的星球上只有你一个人呀！”

paras.en: “Do this to please me. Admire me anyway!”
paras.zh: “就让我高兴一下吧。不管怎样，还是崇拜我吧！”

paras.en: “I admire you,” said the little prince with a little shrug, “but why does that matter to you?”
paras.zh: “我崇拜你，”小王子轻轻耸了耸肩，说，“可这到底有什么值得你在意的呢？”

paras.en: And the little prince went away.
paras.zh: 于是，小王子走了。

paras.en: Grown-ups really are very strange, he simply said to himself as he travelled.
paras.zh: 大人们实在是很奇怪，他在旅途中只是这样对自己说。
